stories.title: Trump's EPA repeals climate pollution limits on fossil fuel power plants
stories.summary: The Trump administration is eliminating all limits on climate-warming pollution from the nation's fossil fuel power plants. Fossil fuel interests hailed the proposal, which likely faces legal challenges from environmental groups.

stories.title: A roundtable on the rapid acceleration of AI
stories.summary: AI companies this weekend pushed out a new message: They want to slow down. This comes after several companies disclosed AI-related security incidents and raised concerns about the technology's future risks.

stories.title: Step, stand, stairs
stories.summary: When it comes to longevity, lots of research has shown how much you move matters. But a new study finds your pace may also be key -- even if you fall far short of daily step goals.

stories.title: Israel is 'dismantling Palestinian life' says Israeli human rights group
stories.summary: One of the country's leading human rights organizations says Israel is dismantling all aspects of Palestinian life at a breakneck rate. The group has extensively documented what it says are the mechanisms Israel has used to "ethnically cleanse" the West Bank of Palestinians.

stories.title: Inside the unprecedented threats election officials are facing ahead of mid-terms
stories.summary: Hundreds of election officials from around the country are meeting to discuss how to defend the integrity of the mid-term elections, including against federal government interference.

stories.title: The true fake story behind the annual Virginia City Camel Race
stories.summary: Back in the 1950s, a newspaper editor in Nevada wrote a fake story about a camel race happening in his town as a joke. Eventually, he helped make it a real thing and the annual Virginia City Camel Race was born, which continues to this day.
